verse.verse_1: Ruin is for every open slanderer, backbiter.
verse.verse_2: Who accumulated wealth and hoarded it, counting.
verse.verse_3: Does he think that his wealth will prolong his stay on earth forever?
verse.verse_4: Never! He will certainly be thrown into the Crushing One.
verse.verse_5: And what have you understood what the Crushing One is!
verse.verse_6: The fire of Allah, that is ablaze.
verse.verse_7: Which will climb on to the hearts.
verse.verse_8: Indeed it will be shut over them.
